title: Jesus Invites His Friends
description: Jesus Invites His Friends in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 692 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Whosoever will, let him come!"”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus in-vites his friends To meet a-round his board, And join in blest com-mu-nion here With him their gra-cious Lord.

lines: And join in blest communion here
For us he gave his life;
For us he gave his blood;
To save from sin our thankless race,
And bring them back to God.
We the young children of his grace,
Pleasure and love fill every mind,

licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
